author: WP01
summary: A 41-entry glossary of renderer selectors, graphics, content, services and project terms. Updated for d6e9ff05 but several entries are stale at TARGET (D3D12 descriptor heaps, HEADLESS readback, ReflectiveReader, MemoryStream, MojoShader scope, WEBGPU, XACT mixer, SDL3 as a requirement). The site had no glossary; all current terms are now defined, corrected and linked on the new reference glossary page.

sections.heading: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: CANVAS: CNA's Emscripten-only HTML canvas based 2D renderer.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: CNA: a native XNA 4.0 reimplementation compiled with a C++23 floor, built on SDL3 with a pluggable renderer layer.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: ContentManager: resolves an asset name; a same-named .xnb is checked first, otherwise a registered loose reader may prefer a .cnj sidecar before its native formats.

target.evidence: docs/content-manager.html (Phase-1): .cnb sits between .xnb and loose files

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: DIRECTX9 / D3D9: the public selector for the Direct3D 9 renderer, the API the zero-tolerance XNA oracle is built around.
tokens: held to XNA's own pixels at tolerance 0

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: DIRECTX11 / D3D11: the Direct3D 11 renderer, sharing a D3DCommon foundation with D3D12 and generating mips with one native GenerateMips call.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: DIRECTX12 / D3D12: no native mip helper, so mip generation is an explicit face-scoped CPU readback, downsample and upload loop.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Descriptor heap: CNA's D3D12 renderer keeps separate RTV, DSV, CBV/SRV/UAV and sampler heaps with fixed-capacity bump allocation and no slot reclamation during a device lifetime, so exhaustion is a CNA limit.
concepts.note: The separate heaps are confirmed; the fixed-capacity, never-reclaimed allocator is not TARGET behaviour.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: FREEDIRECT: the renderer fronting the free-direct sibling, 2D-only like SDL_RENDERER.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: EasyGL profiles: OPENGLES2, OPENGLES3, OPENGL33, WEBGL1 and WEBGL2 share CNA's internal EasyGL factory and the easy-gl sibling; EASYGL is not an accepted selector.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Effect: CNA ships five stock effects plus a renderer-specific runtime-compiled custom ShaderEffect path.

target.evidence: The compiled Effect Framework bytecode route (Effect(GraphicsDevice&, bytes), EffectReader) is a third route

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: ENet: the UDP library behind CNA's Networking implementation, wrapped by an internal ENetBackend, and also behind free-direct's optional DirectPlay transport.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: EXT suffix: a visible naming convention (e.g. GameWindow MinimizeEXT/RestoreEXT) that is not the enforcement mechanism; the CNAEXT marker is.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: FNA: an independent open-source C# reimplementation of XNA 4.0, CNA's primary behavioural reference and the subject of its differential testing, not the Microsoft specification.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Fence (D3D12): CNA records one previous fence value per command-allocator slot (two slots) and waits before reusing a slot; simpler off-screen helpers wait synchronously for deterministic readback.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: GamerServices: implemented with real local persistence where FNA does not implement it at all.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Golden-image test: a captured frame compared with a retained reference under explicit tolerance and environment; reference provenance is part of the claim.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: HEADLESS: never rasterises a pixel; tracks and reports the last Clear() colour; for fast unit testing and unable to produce a real screenshot.

target.evidence: HeadlessRenderer.hpp (HeadlessMode Fast/Validation/Trace; readback throws NotSupportedException, REMED-GFX-162)

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: GraphicsCapability: the enum SupportsCapability takes; not every value answers honestly on every renderer, MRT and occlusion-query false positives are confirmed, and device-dependent limits do not fit a Boolean.
concepts.note: The claimed confirmed false positives are recorded as an issue candidate for verification, not published.

target.evidence: CNA/GraphicsCapability (19 members); base IGraphicsRenderer default permissive; DIRECTX9 inherits it but implements MRT and occlusion queries (DirectX9Renderer.cpp, D3D9OcclusionQuery.cpp); specific false positives not re-established

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: GraphicsDevice: the central class every rendering operation passes through.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: .cnj: CNA's JSON content envelope, considered after .xnb and before native formats for a registered loose reader; typed per loader, not one universal schema.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: .xnb: XNA's compiled content container, read through an explicit finite reader registry; a same-named XNB is checked before loose routes and unsupported readers fail explicitly.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: MojoShader: used by FNA3D for compiled D3D9 effect bytecode; SDL_GPU, EasyGL and Vulkan have experimental opt-ins; not an .fx, DXBC or MGFX loader.

target.evidence: cmake/ThirdPartyFNA3D.cmake; nine CNA_*_COMPILED_EFFECTS options (EasyGL, Vulkan, WebGPU, Software, DirectX 9/11/12, SDL_GPU, OpenGL4) use the MojoShader route

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: MemoryStream: sharp-runtime's in-memory stream; after Close I/O throws ObjectDisposedException but ToArray/GetBuffer still work; its raw-buffer constructor is a known divergence creating a read-only stream.

target.evidence: sharp-runtime@41b918c9 modules/io/include/System/IO/MemoryStream.hpp (MemoryStream(const bytecs*, intcs, bool writable = true))

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: CNAEXT: an empty declaration marker that becomes a deprecation under strict harnesses; distinct from the CNA_CNAEXT option and the CNA::CnaExt link umbrella.
tokens: never removes anything from a build

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Oracle (D3D9): pixel verification of the DIRECTX9 renderer against a genuinely running XNA 4.0 runtime under Wine at zero tolerance.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: PbrEffect: a CNAEXT glTF metallic-roughness material effect with renderer support qualified by the capability matrix.
tokens: FNA3D and PortableGL refuse PBR draws

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: ReflectiveReader<T>: CNA has no equivalent by permanent scope decision; content built with an implicit ReflectiveReader<T> needs an explicit writer/reader pair rebuilt and registered.
concepts.note: CNA reads reflectively serialised XNB types from a declared field list; no rebuilt writer is needed.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SDL3: the cross-platform windowing, input and audio library CNA is built on; not itself a renderer.
tokens: let a build avoid SDL entirely

target.evidence: cmake (CNA_ENABLE_SDL, native X11/Wayland/Win32 platforms); SDL3 is the default, not a requirement

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SDL_GPU: a renderer on SDL3's GPU API using a fixed HLSL-style resource-binding order and runtime GLSL-to-SPIR-V compilation via libshaderc.

target.evidence: SdlGpuSpirvBindings.hpp (SDL_gpu-mandated set layout, push constants to uniform buffers); modules/renderers/sdl-gpu/CMakeLists.txt (libshaderc only for ShaderEffect, never Windows/Apple/Emscripten)

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SDL_RENDERER: CNA's default renderer outside Linux and Emscripten, a thin 2D-only wrapper over SDL3's 2D renderer.
tokens: default everywhere except Linux and Emscripten

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SharpRuntime / sharp-runtime: the sibling C++ reimplementation of a subset of the .NET class library supplying System::Object, TimeSpan, EventHandler<T> and more.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SkinnedModelEXT: the CNA-original real-rendering extension for avatars, separate from the faithful inert Avatar API.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SOFTWARE: a real CPU triangle rasteriser (edge functions, perspective-correct interpolation, per-pixel depth) that can produce a screenshot without a display.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: SpriteBatch: the primary 2D rendering API in XNA and CNA.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Stock effects: BasicEffect, AlphaTestEffect, DualTextureEffect, EnvironmentMapEffect and SkinnedEffect.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: Storage: StorageDevice/StorageContainer over a local filesystem implementation beneath a faithfully preserved fake-async API.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: VertexDeclaration: a renderer-independent vertex layout, pure data, constructible on the 2D-only SDL renderer; the 3D draw using it is where that renderer throws.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: VULKAN: the renderer targeting Vulkan directly.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: WEBGPU: CNA's experimental renderer targeting native wgpu-native.

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: XACT: the Microsoft audio format CNA parses and plays through SDL3_mixer rather than a FAudio-like engine.

target.evidence: modules/audio (selected mixer: SDL3_mixer on SDL3, CNA mixer on ALSA; SDL2/NULL silent)

concepts.section: Glossary of XNA and CNA Terms
concepts.text: xna4-spec: 544 indexed XML type files from the XNA 4.0 documentation across 19 namespaces; CNA does not reference it in source or CI, and converted rows need independent checking.

target.evidence: xna4-spec@fedc17aa index.xml; no reference in CNA 009d40f5
